//: Claude Code MCP config. Copy relevant entries into your project .mcp.json (or run `claude mcp add ...`). Replace ${VARS} via your .env / shell env. See ../docs/02-architecture.md.

blotato.//: Official Blotato hosted MCP. Posts to 9 platforms with scheduledTime; ~16 tools (blotato_create_post, blotato_list_accounts, upload media, blotato_create_visual...). Requires a paid Blotato plan.

higgsfield.//: Official Higgsfield MCP — drives Soul (image), DoP (video), Speak, etc. using your Higgsfield credits. If the hosted form differs, fall back to the community servers (e.g. Hikhakk/higgsfield-mcp-unified) or HTTP tool-use against platform.higgsfield.ai. Confirm the current MCP URL/transport at higgsfield.ai/mcp.

filesystem.//: Optional: scoped read/write to the content store + media cache.
